title: Butterfly dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- left upper wing -->
    <path d="M48 50 C36 26, 14 20, 10 34 C6 47, 24 54, 48 50 Z" fill="#ff7ac8"/>
    <path d="M48 50 C34 30, 18 28, 15 37 C13 45, 28 51, 48 50 Z" fill="#ffd1f0"/>
    <!-- left lower wing -->
    <path d="M48 52 C36 62, 22 78, 26 86 C30 94, 44 78, 48 52 Z" fill="#ff9ad8"/>
    <path d="M48 52 C38 63, 29 75, 31 81 C34 87, 43 76, 48 52 Z" fill="#ffe3f6"/>
    <!-- right upper wing -->
    <path d="M52 50 C64 26, 86 20, 90 34 C94 47, 76 54, 52 50 Z" fill="#7ad3ff"/>
    <path d="M52 50 C66 30, 82 28, 85 37 C87 45, 72 51, 52 50 Z" fill="#d6f1ff"/>
    <!-- right lower wing -->
    <path d="M52 52 C64 62, 78 78, 74 86 C70 94, 56 78, 52 52 Z" fill="#9adfff"/>
    <path d="M52 52 C62 63, 71 75, 69 81 C66 87, 57 76, 52 52 Z" fill="#e6f8ff"/>
    <!-- wing spots -->
    <circle cx="27" cy="38" r="4" fill="#7a3a8f"/>
    <circle cx="73" cy="38" r="4" fill="#2f6fb0"/>
    <circle cx="36" cy="72" r="3" fill="#7a3a8f"/>
    <circle cx="64" cy="72" r="3" fill="#2f6fb0"/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="4" ry="14" fill="#ffe066"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="2" ry="12" fill="#fff6c2"/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="4" fill="#ffcc33"/>
    <!-- antennae -->
    <path d="M48 39 C44 32, 40 28, 38 24" stroke="#ffcc33" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M52 39 C56 32, 60 28, 62 24" stroke="#ffcc33" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="37" cy="23" r="2.5" fill="#fff18a"/>
    <circle cx="63" cy="23" r="2.5" fill="#fff18a"/>
    <!-- dance sparkles -->
    <circle cx="20" cy="58" r="2" fill="#fff18a"/>
    <circle cx="80" cy="58" r="2" fill="#fff18a"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="2" fill="#fff18a"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="84" r="2" fill="#fff18a"/>
  </g>
</svg>
